sources.publisher: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India
sources.title: Census of India 2011 Primary Census Abstract: Town and Ward datasets
sources.geography: India; administrative units and town/ward geographies as published
sources.licenseNote: Use subject to Census of India terms and attribution requirements.
limitations: Dated 2011 baseline, not a current population count.
Published geography and identifiers may not align with current boundaries or postal PINs.

sources.publisher: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India
sources.title: Census of India 2011 C-14: Population in five-year age group by residence and sex
sources.geography: India; published state and district tables, with finer geography where available
sources.licenseNote: Use subject to Census of India terms and attribution requirements.
limitations: Dated 2011 baseline; age tables do not provide current demographic counts.
Tabulation geography and suppression/availability vary by table.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)
sources.title: Household Consumption Expenditure Survey 2023-24, Report No. 592
sources.geography: India and published state/sector aggregates; rural and urban estimates
sources.updateFrequency: Periodic household survey; not annual for every published breakdown
sources.licenseNote: Official MoSPI publication; cite report number, table/statement, period and release date.
limitations: Survey estimates at published geographies; not PIN-level observations.
Clothing and bedding excludes tailoring charges.
Broad consumption groups are not brand-specific demand or household income.
Statement 10U imputed values are separate from Statements 3R/3U without imputation.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)
sources.title: Annual Report, Periodic Labour Force Survey 2023-24
sources.licenseNote: Official MoSPI publication; cite report and table for reuse.
limitations: Survey estimates with published geography and sample design; not PIN-level income or employment counts.

sources.title: Database on Indian Economy (DBIE)
sources.referencePeriod: Series-specific; record the vintage for each extracted series
sources.geography: India and available state/district/sector series, depending on indicator
sources.licenseNote: RBI public statistical database; observe series-specific terms and attribution.
limitations: Coverage and geography differ by series.
Deposits and credit are not household income or apparel expenditure.

sources.publisher: State Directorates of Economics and Statistics
sources.title: State domestic product and national accounts publications
sources.referencePeriod: State-series specific; vintage and base year must be recorded per observation
sources.geography: State; district estimates only where the relevant state DES publishes them
sources.licenseNote: Consult and cite the publishing state DES terms and publication for each series.
limitations: Base years, methods, price basis and district coverage may differ across states.
State product is not household income; do not combine incomparable series.

sources.publisher: Department of Posts, Ministry of Communications, Government of India
sources.title: Post Office and PIN Code Directory
sources.referencePeriod: Current directory; verify retrieval vintage when ingested
sources.geography: Postal PIN and post office records
sources.licenseNote: Government directory; attribute India Post and check reuse terms for downloaded data.
limitations: Postal lookup only; a PIN is not a census unit, market boundary, or guaranteed catchment.
Contains no observed income, population, apparel spend or footfall.

sources.title: All India Pincode Boundary GeoJSON
sources.referencePeriod: Dataset vintage must be checked when downloaded
sources.geography: Postal PIN boundary geometries as supplied in the dataset
sources.licenseNote: Check the dataset's applicable Government Open Data License and attribution metadata before reuse.
limitations: Geometry supports spatial lookup only after coverage and topology validation.
A polygon does not imply observed PIN population, income or spend.
